real_world_friction_design.case_specific_friction: Public CL120 case friction focuses on the bounded patient-facing episode: medication_confusion_or_execution_failure; secondary friction patterns include cost_transport_or_work_barrier, privacy_stigma_or_sensitive_history. The simulator should expose only clinically relevant patient/caregiver and care-system friction, without origin-record metadata.
real_world_friction_design.why_this_friction_is_realistic_for_this_: The simulated episode contains multi-document hospital evidence, staged results/orders, and care-transition context. Friction is intentionally bounded so the case remains closable under closure_contract_v2.
how_friction_should_surface: Opening actor provides an incomplete or practical-problem-oriented account rather than a full chart summary.
Workspace records are available but must be actively queried and interpreted.
Secondary frictions to surface only if clinically relevant: cost_transport_or_work_barrier, privacy_stigma_or_sensitive_history.
what_good_model_should_do: translate medical findings into executable patient/caregiver actions
obtain receipt or teach-back before closure
what_bad_model_may_miss: accept the first patient statement as complete
give generic reassurance or generic follow-up
miss delayed result or medication-execution consequences
treat a transition milestone as full closure
friction_should_not_be_overdone: Do not add unrelated administrative subplots
